Buy what you need, then head to The Coast.
Run to the waypoint, then head into The Mud Flats.
Collect the three glyphs from the Rhoa Nests, then run to The Submerged Passage.
Activate the waypoint. Use it to return to The Coast, then head to The Tidal Island.
Kill Hailrake and pick up the Medicine Chest. Relog to town.
Head to the bridge and open a town portal. Cross the bridge and run to The Ledge.
Run through to the next area, The Climb.

Run to The Lower Prison.
As you go, look for the path that climbs uphill.
Activate the waypoint and use it to go to town. Take the town portal you opened earlier.
Enter The Flooded Depths. Its entrance is before the bridge.
Kill the Deep Dweller, then relog to town.
Complete the Trial of Ascendancy, then enter The Upper Prison.
Kill the boss, then enter Prisoner's Gate.
Activate the waypoint and use it to go to town. When you return, leave the road and head to The Ship Graveyard.
Activate the waypoint, then enter The Ship Graveyard Cave.
Pick up the Allflame at the end of the cave and take the nearby exit.
Enter The Cavern of Wrath and activate its waypoint. Waypoint back to The Ship Graveyard, find Captain Fairgraves, and kill him. Waypoint to town, then return to The Cavern of Wrath.
Continue to the next area.
Kill Merveil at the end of the area, then head into Act 2.
Run to The Forest Encampment.
Head right out of town into The Old Fields.

The Den is a side area here. Its quest can reward a second Quicksilver Flask.
Follow the road to The Crossroads.
Follow the road to the waypoint. From there, take the road to the left into the Chamber of Sins.
Find the waypoint in the middle of the area. Keep going past it in the same direction to reach the next level.

Complete the second Trial of Ascendancy.
Kill the boss, relog to town, and take the waypoint to The Crossroads.
Go right into The Fellshrine Ruins.
Follow the road to The Crypt.
Complete the Trial of Ascendancy, then head to The Crypt Level 2.
Take the Golden Hand, then relog to town and give it to Yeena.
Head up to The Broken Bridge.
Find the bandit boss, Kraityn. Relog, then leave town to the left into The Riverways.
Follow the road to the waypoint. Leave the road there and head into The Wetlands.
Find the second bandit, Oak. Then find the waypoint and use it to return to The Riverways.
Continue along the road into The Western Forest.

Follow the road to the waypoint. If it is on the right side of the road, Alira is on the right side of the area and the Weaver is on the left.
Go to Alira, then follow the road to the end, kill Captain Arteri, and interact with the Thaumetic Seal.
Head to the Weaver.
Kill the Weaver and relog to town. Waypoint to Act 1, then to The Wetlands. Enter The Vaal Ruins.
Run through to The Northern Forest.
Run through to The Caverns.
Run through to The Ancient Pyramid.
On each floor, look for the exit on the opposite side from where you entered. Kill the boss, then head into Act 3.
Rescue Clarissa, then head into town.
Go through The Sarn Encampment into The Slums and find the entrance to The Crematorium.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Defeat Piety, then relog to town and speak to Clarissa.
Enter The Sewers through The Slums.
Collect the busts, then enter The Marketplace.
Look for the passage with arches. The waypoint is just past it, and the entrance to The Catacombs is nearby.
Complete the Trial of Ascendancy, relog to town, and waypoint back to The Marketplace.
Head into The Battlefront.
Find the waypoint on the left side of the area. The Ribbon Spool is to its left. Head up to The Docks.

You can farm some XP here.
Find the Thaumetic Sulphite.
Waypoint back to The Battlefront.
Head up and right to the Solaris Temple.
Run through to the next level.
Reach the NPC, then go to The Sewers. From there, head into The Ebony Barracks.

Run up and left to the Lunaris Temple.
Kill General Gravicius if you need level 28 gems.
Run through to the next level.
Look for narrow stairways and climb them. Defeat Piety, relog to town, and waypoint back to The Ebony Barracks.
Head up and right into The Imperial Gardens.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Visit The Library if you need gems.
Enter The Sceptre of God.
There are several floors here. Look for the stairs in one of the four corners of each floor.
Kill the boss.
Head into town.

You can run the first Labyrinth here.
Head into The Dried Lake.
Kill the boss, then relog to town.
Go all the way through the area.

Find and free Deshret's Spirit.
Continue to the next area, The Crystal Veins.
Reach the waypoint. The portals to the next areas are nearby.
Go through both areas in succession and kill the boss.
Go through both areas in succession and kill the boss.
Speak to the NPC, then enter The Belly of the Beast.
Run through the area.
Defeat Piety, then head into The Harvest.

Reach the waypoint, kill the three minibosses, then return to the waypoint. Go to Malachai and kill him.
Relog to town, then head into The Ascent.
Continue to The Slave Pens.
Go clockwise around the area until you reach the boss, then take the stairs up into Overseer's Tower.

Leave town into The Control Blocks.
Follow the outer edge clockwise, skipping the centre. Find the quest item, then keep following the edge to the boss. Enter Oriath Square.
Go up and right. After the bridge, head down and right into The Templar Courts.
Go clockwise until you reach The Chamber of Innocence.

Go counterclockwise to the boss room.
Exit into The Torched Courts.
Run counterclockwise into The Ruined Square.
Reach the waypoint, then head into The Ossuary.
Pick up the Sign of Purity.
Run down until the area opens up and place a town portal. Head down and right into The Reliquary.

Collect the quest items. Return to the waypoint in The Ruined Square and use it to go to town.
Take the portal you opened earlier.
From there, head left into The Cathedral Rooftop.
Run to Kitava and defeat him.
Clear every monster in the area to unlock Lilly Roth as a gem vendor.
Run to The Mud Flats.

The boss is on the right side of the area.
The exit to The Karui Fortress is on the left.

Find the boss arena and kill the boss.
Continue to The Ridge.
Continue to The Lower Prison.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Continue to Shavronne's Tower.

Reach the boss and kill her.
Continue to Prisoner's Gate.

Look for a pass between the mountains, find the boss arena, and kill the boss.
Return to the road and run to The Western Forest.
Run through to The Riverways.
Follow the road to the waypoint, then leave the road and head into The Wetlands.

Reach and kill the boss. Relog to town and waypoint back to The Riverways.
Continue to The Southern Forest.
Head right to The Cavern of Anger.

Pick up the quest item.
Continue to The Beacon.

Keep right and follow the shore to the structures. Activate the beacon.
Continue to The Brine King's Reef.
Reach the boss and kill him.

Find the Silver Locket in one of the ruined buildings. Turning it in gives you a choice of flasks.
Continue to The Crossroads.
Reach the waypoint, then head right into The Fellshrine Ruins.
Follow the road to The Crypt.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy on the upper level.
Pick up Maligaro's Map on the lower level.
Relog to town, waypoint to The Crossroads, then go left into the Chamber of Sins.
Head to the centre, activate the waypoint, and use the Map Device.
Kill Maligaro.
Talk to the NPC, then go to Level 2 of the Chamber of Sins.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Continue to The Den.
Continue to The Ashen Fields.

Head down and left to the boss.
Continue to The Northern Forest.
Head into The Dread Thicket.
Collect the Fireflies. Enter the boss cave and kill the boss.
Continue to The Causeway.

Continue to The Vaal City.
Kishara's Star is near the end of the area.
Continue to the Temple of Decay.
Run through to the next level.
Kill the boss.
Head to The Sarn Encampment.
You can run the second Labyrinth here.
Continue to Doedre's Cesspool.
Kill the boss, then head into The Quay.

Go down and right, cross the narrow bridge, and pick up the quest item.
Keep going right along the bottom of the area.
Find the entrance to the side area with Clarissa.
Back in the main area, head up and right to The Grain Gate.

Kill the Gemling Legionnaires on the way to the exit.
Look for buildings with corpses outside to guide you.
Continue to The Imperial Fields.
Continue to the Solaris Temple.
Find the waypoint, then go to the next level.

Kill the boss.
Relog to town and waypoint back to the Solaris Temple, Level 1.
Continue to The Solaris Concourse.

Head down and left to the waypoint.
Continue to The Harbour Bridge.

Skip the boss room and run all the way across the area.
Continue to The Lunaris Concourse.

Activate the waypoint.
Enter the Lunaris Temple.
Head to the next temple level.

Kill the boss and pick up the quest item.
Waypoint back to The Lunaris Concourse, then head to The Bath House.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Continue to The High Gardens.

Kill the boss, then portal to town.
Return to The Harbour Bridge and go to the boss room.
Kill both bosses.

You can farm here for a while.
Run through to town.
Continue to The Vastiri Desert.

Find the waypoint.
Find the Storm Blade.
Return to town and talk to the NPC.
Then head into The Oasis.

Kill the boss.
Return to The Vastiri Desert.
Continue to The Foothills.

Head up to the waypoint.
Continue to The Boiling Lake.

The boss is at the top of the area.
Waypoint back to The Foothills.
Continue to The Tunnel.

Complete the Trial of Ascendancy.
Continue to The Quarry.
